risk.short: Trading leveraged products carries a high level of risk and may not be suitable for everyone. Instant-funded accounts are simulated: no real capital is traded and past performance is no guarantee of future results. Nothing on this page is investment advice.

design.title: Components & tokens
design.subtitle: Every colour lives in one tokens file. This page shows each building block in light and dark mode before we assemble the landing page.

colors.title: Colours
colors.description: Swatches read straight from tokens.css — switch the theme to see the dark palette.

cards.title: Cards & icon tiles

meters.title: Meters
meters.description: Blue = safe, yellow = near limit, red = breached. State is shown with an icon and text too.

markets.title: 24/7 markets
markets.body: Crypto markets never close — neither does the platform.
